title: LookObjects
description: Data file content/look/objects.json: how the core's objects (trees, bushes, berries, water sources, stones ...) are drawn on the island in the main game. Each object type maps to one simple shape of the look prototype (D569) in palette colours; size and turn vary per object, derived from its id (same picture at every start). A type without an entry gets the calm neutral fallback marker and is logged once. Presentation only, not part of the hash.

outline.description: Whether objects get the ink outline pass.

outline_width_m.description: Width of the ink outline hull in metres.

outline_mitre_limit.description: How thick the ink outline may get at a sharp corner of a flat-shaded rock (stones, the rock niche; TL #20750), in outline widths. Where the faces of such a rock meet at a corner the outline is pushed out along their common direction, and further the sharper the corner is, so that every face still lies one whole width off the body (a mitre); a spike is capped at this many widths. 1 = no mitre (thinner outline at corners). Shapes with smooth normals (trees, bushes, plants) are pushed out along their normals by exactly one width and do not use it.

ground_tolerance_m.description: How far (metres) the underside of an object lying on the ground (align ground or ground_uphill) may float above or sink below the drawn ground within its footprint (D576, TL #19553). A lying object whose best fit is worse (for example across a rock wall) stands upright instead; the tests hold every object of the start island to it. Placeholder value.

turn_tries.description: Turns a long lying object (a log) tries over half a circle when its own turn (from its id) does not fit the ground within half the tolerance; it keeps the best fitting one. Placeholder value.

min_footprint_m.description: Smallest footprint radius (metres) over which a lying object samples the ground, so even a tiny one finds the slope. Placeholder value.

decor.description: Decorative plants drawn by the presentation only (TL #19722): grass tufts, flowers, shrubs in groups on the dry walkable ground of named biomes, placed from the world seed. They are no core objects, have no state and are never saved; they keep off the core's objects and off water. Absent = none.

ObjectLookShape.description: Shape builder of the game (simple low-poly meshes of the look prototype); none draws nothing (for example sea water, the sea is drawn already); spring is a small heap of stones a stream comes out of (W1724), pool a small pond; rock_niche is a shelter in a rock wall (TL #20750): a dark opening under a lintel between side rocks, its measures in the visual's niche.

ObjectLookFallback.description: Calm neutral marker for object types without an entry.

colors.description: Palette colour ids (content/look/palette.json) by role: 0 main (crown, body, stone, water, cap, fruit), 1 second (trunk, berries, rim, stem, bloom, cut end, heads), 2 third (second crown layer, fruit on a tree). A shape with more roles than colours repeats them from the start.

size_m.description: Size factor (1 = the shape's base size).

ObjectVisual.description: Shape and colours for one or more object types.

types.description: Object type ids (content/objects) drawn this way.

colors.description: Palette colour ids (content/look/palette.json) by role: 0 main (crown, body, stone, water, cap, fruit), 1 second (trunk, berries, rim, stem, bloom, cut end, heads), 2 third (second crown layer, fruit on a tree). A shape with more roles than colours repeats them from the start.

size_m.description: Size factor (1 = the shape's base size).

size_jitter.description: Size varies per object by up to this share either way (calm variety).

lift_m.description: Height above the ground in metres (negative sinks it in a little).

footprint_m.description: Radius in metres (at size factor 1) over which the object meets the ground: rest lowest/highest samples it, align ground fits the slope to it (for a long object: half its length along its local x axis).

footprint_width_m.description: Half width in metres (at size factor 1) of an elongated footprint across its local x axis (a log); absent = round (footprint_m).

sway_m.description: How far the top moves in full wind, in metres at size factor 1 (content/look/nature.json wind); absent = it stands still.

ObjectNiche.description: Measures of the shape rock_niche (TL #20750), in metres at size factor 1, and how it finds the wall it leans on. The rock stands with its local +x side in the wall and opens at its local -x side: a dark opening (colour role 2, drawn unlit, so it stays dark in every light) under a lintel that juts out over it, between two side rocks (role 1), in a body of rock (role 0) that reaches back into the wall and down below the ground. A visual with this shape must carry it. Placeholder values.

opening_width_m.description: Width of the opening at the ground.

opening_height_m.description: Height of the opening at its highest point.

front_m.description: How far the foot of the opening lies in front of the object's position. The object stands at the foot of the wall, where the ground already rises; the opening stands this far out on the level ground before it.

depth_m.description: How far the dark hollow reaches into the rock behind the opening.

side_rock_m.description: Thickness of the rock at either side of the opening.

lintel_m.description: Thickness of the rock above the opening.

overhang_m.description: How far the lintel juts out over the foot of the opening.

back_m.description: How far the rock reaches back from the object's position into the wall it leans on.

sink_m.description: How far the rock reaches below the object's position, so it sits flush on uneven ground.

roughness.description: How uneven the rock is: its corners move by up to this share of the rock's thickness (0 = smooth).

wall_probe_m.description: Radius in metres around the object in which the ground is searched for the wall (align wall): the higher ground there is the wall.

wall_min_rise_m.description: How far the ground must rise within the probe radius to count as a wall; on flatter ground the object keeps the turn from its id.

ObjectLookRest.description: Which ground height an upright object stands on: centre (the ground under its position), lowest or highest ground within its footprint. Objects that lie on the ground (align ground, ground_uphill) follow the slope instead and ignore it.

ObjectLookAlign.description: How an object meets the ground (D576): upright stands straight up on its rest height (trees, bushes, plants); ground lies on the ground and follows its slope (logs, stones), turned from its id towards the turn that fits the ground best; ground_uphill lies on the ground like ground with its local +x side facing uphill (a spring pool with its stones at the uphill side); wall stands upright with its local +x side turned to the higher ground around it (the rock wall it leans on, searched within niche.wall_probe_m), so its local -x side faces the open ground (a rock niche, TL #20750).

type.description: Decor type id; a visual of this file lists it in its types (it must not be an object type of the catalogue).

biomes.description: Biome ids whose dry walkable cells carry it.

groups_per_10000_cells.description: Groups per 10000 cells of those biomes.

spread_m.description: Largest distance of a plant from its group centre in metres.

min_spacing_m.description: Smallest distance between two decorative plants in metres.

min_object_distance_m.description: Smallest distance from any core object at the start in metres.

fresh_water_within_cells.description: Bank plants (W1724): only a cell with fresh water (a stream, a spring, a lake, a swamp) within this many cells may hold a group centre, so groups_per_10000_cells is the density along the water. Absent = anywhere in the biomes.

ObjectStreamSources.description: Objects at the source of a stream (W1724): an object of one of object_types that lies within max_distance_m of the point where a stream band starts at a spring is drawn as the visual of as_type instead, at that point and turned against the flow (its local +x side uphill), so the water comes out of it and runs straight into the band. Objects of those types elsewhere (a pond in a hollow, at a lake) keep their own visual. Absent = none.

as_type.description: Type id a visual of this file lists in its types (it must not be an object type of the catalogue).

max_distance_m.description: Largest distance between the object and the start of the stream band in metres.

ObjectGlow.description: A look that gives light (M2 find, TL #23595: fire, spark): its body is drawn self-lit, so it shows at night too, and each such object carries a warm point light that flickers. Presentation only; absent = an ordinary lit look.

light_color.description: Palette colour id of the light.

light_energy.description: Strength of the light (0 = no light, the body still glows).

light_range_m.description: How far the light reaches, in metres at size factor 1.

light_height_m.description: Height of the light above the object's foot, in metres at size factor 1.

flicker.description: Share of the strength that wavers (0 = steady).

flicker_hz.description: How fast it wavers (calm: a few times a second at most).
